d.ko: Are you ready for the first Yoyovania?! In this 2D top-down adventure you'll explore a sprawling urban landscape, reinterpreting your surroundings through your mastery of yoyo tricks. Navigate the city's many districts, fight rival crime bosses, and regain the influence of the Pipistrello family!

The best Nintendo game Nintendo never made. Infuses the top-down Zelda formula with fresh new mechanics and uses them to great effect with incredible room and puzzle design. …

This game looks like a classic Zelda but has a great move set and amazing world to explore. The room design, dungeon design and over world design are seriously genius. Honestly this game didn't get the recognition it deserves.
应该算第一次正儿八经玩的类塞游戏，真的太好玩了！！各种交互探索，解谜房间真的做的特别有意思 。感觉还比较偏类银的玩法，各种护符槽，技能树，新技能，跳跳乐，打boss，探图，技能锁等等，作为喜欢类银的玩家玩的特别爽！！ …
一款真正好玩的 连战完了接跳跳乐 跳跳乐完了接boss战 含大量能力锁 能自由探索 大部分时间在粪坑（指下水道） 2D的 Steam76块钱的游戏
好游戏，但没中文，据说民汉拿着成品去找发行商都被无视。我看这确实算不上无视中国市场，基本就是藐视中国市场
